title: Candidate Period Discrete Measurement Correspondence Audit
scientific_question: Under which declared measurement conditions can two Candidate Period observations be scientifically considered corresponding?
preregistered_correspondence_criterion: Two Candidate Periods have experiment-local lineage-supported correspondence when at least two identical adjacent source-observation pairs support the first period and, after the declared controlled transformation and measurement operation, support the second period.
hypotheses: Non-identical discrete Candidate Period measurements can preserve lineage-supported correspondence.
Grid phase can change Candidate Period measurement while the source observation identities remain fixed.
Grid resolution can change Candidate Period measurement while the source observation identities remain fixed.
Shared supporting-event lineage can distinguish correspondence evidence from numerical similarity without tolerance.
scientific_classification: LINEAGE-SUPPORTED CORRESPONDENCE ESTABLISHED WITHIN CONTROLLED REMEASUREMENT SCOPE
